chunks: For indeed the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Between my grave and my pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise, and indeed my pulpit is upon one of the pathways of Paradise."

key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise; the abode of divine reward
key_terms.تُرْعَةٍ: a pathway or channel; here, a route associated with Paradise
key_terms.رَوْضَةٌ: a garden; here, a blessed garden-like space linked to Paradise
key_terms.رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ: the gardens of Paradise; indicating heavenly merit and sanctity
key_terms.قَبْرِي: my grave; the blessed burial place of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مِنْبَرِي: my pulpit; the place from which the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم addressed the people

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about the area between his grave and pulpit?
ai.summary: This hadith states the special sanctity and spiritual excellence of the area between the grave of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and his pulpit. It presents that space as being connected to Paradise and highlights the immense merit of the Prophet’s mosque and visitation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3158 - It is narrated that the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Between my grave and my pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise, and my pulpit is upon one of the pathways to Paradise."
